passages.text:
The King: Bring forth my Queen Vashti so the people may gaze upon her beauty and splendor and the Majesty of her crown.
 
 [[Eunuch's Response]]
passages.name: King's address

passages.text:
Delay is the ally of your enemy.
[[Memucan Optional]]
passages.name: Marsena

passages.text:
O my lord the king, this deed of the queen is not done against thee only, but also against all the princes and against all the provinces of thy kingdom. For if this thing be suffered, the women shall despise their husbands in their eyes, and there shall arise contempt and wrath. If it please the king, let there go forth a royal decree that Vashti come no more before the king, and let her royal estate be given unto another that is better than she.
[[The King 3]]
passages.name: Memucan

passages.text: What is done in the palace echoes through every home.
passages.name: Memucan Optional

passages.text:
Memucan: The Queen's transgression was not just towards you My Lord, but against the princes of every province. For if allowed to stand she may cause revolt within the hearts of all the women turned towards their husbands. If it pleases the King, let there be a decree that Vashti may no longer come before you and that her title shall be given to another.
[[Bigtha]]
passages.name: Memucan's response

passages.text:
Loyalty lasts only as long as it profits.
[[Marsena]]
passages.name: Meres

passages.text:
Queen Vashti: Mine king, Mine husband is of drunkenness I refuse to display for our people!

[[Xerxes Response]]
